item: Law floor reason and status shown in words, data as data (row 317)
summary: Living sources > Law > language floor glued the report's raw English reason onto translated sentences; one named configs/language_countries.yml as prose. When the floor gives no country the sentence now comes from its read state (row 279: absent / empty / unreadable, 3 new strings x12), the error shown as labelled data; the catalogue's read error sits under an Error label as data; a non-drafted verification_status (the file's own free text) is shown as data inside the translated frame. Values carry dir=ltr so they isolate in RTL.
